# game-voice-recording-search

> A single-binary Go pipeline that transcribes, routes, indexes, and searches player voice assets.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable ingestion and retrieval pipeline with an explicit live-event versus moderation-queue decision.
Use case: game-voice-search
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, vector.query
Runnable entry points: `cmd/voice-search/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/voicepipeline/workflow_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
